title: Resume
subtitle: Fintech engineering leader across trading platforms, payments, and the teams that ship them

summary.title: Profile
summary.content: Full-stack engineering leader with 8+ years building and scaling web and mobile products in regulated fintech, from trading platforms at Deriv to consumer payments at MoneyLion, serving millions of users worldwide. I lead a team of 6 engineers including 2 tech leads, built Deriv's mobile app from scratch to 500K+ installs and 50K daily active users, and shipped the DWallet programme to production as TradersHub. My work sits where engineering meets trust: OAuth2 and passkeys, KYC and identity verification, disaster recovery, and the automation that catches problems before customers do. I also teach, having coached 250+ students into their first engineering roles.

stat3.label: Applications migrated to OAuth2 / OpenID Connect

job1.title: Tech Team Lead - Web Platform Fullstack
bullets: Lead a team of 6 engineers including 2 tech leads, and own SLOs and SLIs for client-facing trading applications.
Built and launched Deriv's mobile app from scratch, taking it from zero to 500K+ installs and 50K daily active users.
Completed and released the DWallet programme to production as TradersHub, finishing work I had previously led on the frontend.

Built the authentication platform end to end: OAuth2 with public clients (OpenID Connect) rolled out across 7 applications, plus passkeys, MFA (TOTP), trusted-device flows, and mobile app integrity verification.
Built CI automation across the software delivery lifecycle, carrying work from requirement through to opened pull request.
Built automated monitoring and alerting over user data that surfaces skew and anomalies to the business before they reach customers.
Architected and led the disaster recovery solution for Deriv applications, running the design sessions and driving implementation across teams.
Led development of an AI-assisted KYC solution for proof of identity and proof of address, cutting manual review from the onboarding path.

job2.title: Mobile Team Lead
bullets: Promoted to lead mobile engineering after a year on the team.
Drove organisation-wide initiatives to strengthen the design system and monitoring infrastructure.
Maintained 99.9%+ availability across mobile payment features serving millions of users.
Owned iOS and Android release and deployment pipelines end to end.

job3.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
bullets: Built, shipped, and documented mobile payment features using React Native, Redux, and Redux Saga.
Partnered closely with product managers, backend engineers, and QA to keep payment flows reliable at scale.

job4.title: Lead Frontend Developer
bullets: Led a team of 6 engineers delivering DWallet features and maintaining Deriv.com and Deriv.app.
Set frontend architecture and review practice across the trading platform, mentoring engineers into greater ownership.

job5.title: Senior Frontend Developer
bullets: Built Deriv, a new financial trading platform, using React with MobX.
Integrated the Onfido identity verification API across Binary.com and Deriv.com.
Developed the Deriv.com product landing page with Gatsby, and integrated the platform with marketing and analytics tooling.

job6.title: Software Engineering Lecturer
bullets: Lectured and coached 250+ students across cities in Indonesia into their first software engineering roles.
Taught industry practice in frontend and backend development, grounded in real production experience.

writing.title: Ventures, Writing & Community
writing.content: Co-founder of Qlassku, an IT services and consulting venture built alongside my full-time engineering work. I also write about the craft on DEV Community, including a MobX 6 and React hooks guide that remains the reference I get asked about most, and keep a public body of work on GitHub, from Islamic inheritance and Hijri calendar tools to a Malaysian take-home pay calculator.
